identityModel: Native FIFA assetId is the canonical version-1 identity; WEFUT page ids are lookup keys only and are never emitted as FIFA asset/resource ids.
note: Built from the bundled 16,515 FIFA 14 FUT card-stat rows by joining each WeFUT record id to WeFUT's native data-base-id/data-club-id/data-league-id/data-nation-id metadata. The active pool contains one launch-era base card per EA assetId; special/World Cup rows remain bundled source data for a later versioned-resource catalogue. BETA 2.26.1 supplements 56 missing goalkeeper identities across gold/silver/bronze tiers. Local hotfix: removed only Jean-François Gillet (Torino, assetId 105308), whose identity renders incorrectly on the target FIFA 14 PC client. Repair scan: added Ochoa 140233 and Kaká 138449; corrected verified identity joins and user-reported cards; Jean-François Gillet 105308 remains removed.
